item.title: Unexpected Reboot During Autopilot ESP — Diagnosing and Fixing the Device Already Enrolled Error
item.description: An unexpected reboot mid-Autopilot provisioning was causing a misleading Device Already Enrolled error on re-enrollment. Here is what caused it and how it was fixed.

item.title: SSPR Not Showing on Windows Lock Screen — The GPO Conflict Nobody Checked
item.description: How a security hardening GPO silently blocked SSPR on the Windows lock screen for over a year — and how investigating the right Group Policy settings and their related registry keys finally solved it.
